blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets on your Mac

Google Sheets does not have a native Mac application. You use it through a web browser. Google Chrome provides the most reliable experience. You can turn any sheet into a dedicated app window. Open Chrome, navigate to your sheet, and click the three-dot menu. Select Cast, Save, and Share, then pick Install page as app. This places an icon in your dock. It keeps your spreadsheets separate from your other browser tabs.

Speed is vital when you manage large marketing reports. Use these shortcuts to move through your data without your mouse. Press ⌘ + / to see the full list of shortcuts. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to find and replace text in your data. If you need to hide rows to focus on a specific campaign, select them and press ⌘ + ⌥ + 9. To hide columns, use ⌘ + ⌥ + 0.

items: Use ⌥ + / to open the tool finder.
Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to trigger find and replace.

blocks.text: Marketing data grows fast. You might hit the 20 million cell limit if you track granular ad performance over years. Clean your data before you import it. Use the split text to columns feature to separate campaign names from IDs. Remove duplicate rows to ensure your ROI calculations are accurate. If your sheet feels slow, remove unused tabs and unnecessary formulas. Reference data from other sheets using the import range function instead of pasting everything into one file.

One common error is hardcoding values into formulas. Always use cell references. This makes your reports dynamic. When you change a date or a budget value, your calculations update automatically. Another mistake is ignoring the revision history. If you accidentally delete a formula, go to File > Version history > See version history to restore your work. Do not trust manual data entry for critical metrics. Use data validation to create dropdown lists for campaign sources.

Lazur sits in your Mac notch. It helps you find functions or settings you do not use often. If you forget how to freeze the top row, just hold ⌥ + ⌘ and ask Lazur. It circles the correct menu item on your screen. You can also ask Lazur to guide you through complex tasks like creating a pivot table one step at a time. It waits for you to perform each action before moving to the next.

faq.question: Is there an official Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google Sheets is a web-based app. You can install it as a Progressive Web App (PWA) in Chrome to get a dedicated icon in your dock.

faq.question: What is the cell limit for a single sheet?
faq.answer: As of September 2026, the limit is 20 million cells per spreadsheet.

faq.question: How can I find keyboard shortcuts in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + / while in any sheet to open the shortcut menu.

faq.question: Does Lazur edit my spreadsheets?
faq.answer: No, Lazur never edits files or clicks buttons for you. It points at the screen and explains how to perform tasks.
